title: AWS Step Functions to Amazon Polly to Amazon S3 with CDK (Typescript)
description: Step Functions - Polly SDK integration for text to speech output as mp3 into s3 .

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This project demonstrates how to implement a State Function State machine to synthesize given words using Amazon Polly and save each mp3 generated in a S3 bucket.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.

authors.name: Pubudu Jayawardana
